classifier.error_upper_bound: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper endpoint: Beta^{-1}(0.95; errors+1, test_n-errors)
classifier.guarantee: finite-sample conditional on the fitted classifier and held-out iid test observations
classifier.test_error_definition: 1 - accuracy on the held-out test split

actual_h5_schema.note: The artifact has no root-level cols node; APP, PPI and PPI_LEN were read from each actual /flows/* table in bounded chunks.

channel_inference.what_the_3_means: PPI leading dimension is three measured packet channels. Project dataset notes state first-30-packet sequences contain packet size, direction, and inter-packet time; artifact statistics identify row 1 as direction, row 2 as size, and row 0 as the remaining timing-like channel. Only direction and size are used for this readout.

lower_side_reference.guarantee: asymptotic HPLB estimate; not an exact finite-sample certificate
